entities.name: Della
entities.description: An angel of New Capenna, a healer and warrior who gave part of her Halo to save Errant and Parnesse and joined the resistance against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Errant
entities.description: A character of New Capenna rescued and healed by Della; she is wed to Parnesse.

entities.name: Parnesse
entities.description: A character of New Capenna rescued and healed by Della, with Errant.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A Phyrexian the resistance planned to lure into a trap.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The plane where Della and the resistance fight the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders of New Capenna, opposed by the resistance.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault during which Della acted.

events.summary: Della finds Errant and Parnesse after an explosion and heals their wounds with her angelic powers.
events.quote: Della found and rescued Errant and Parnesse after an explosion, using her angelic powers to heal their severe wounds.

events.summary: Della joins the planning of the resistance's operation to lure Atraxa into a trap.
events.quote: Della later joined the planning of the resistance's critical operation, offering her support to lure Atraxa into a trap.

events.summary: Della catches the falling Errant as the city crumbles, saving her again.
events.quote: Della saved Errant again, catching her mid-fall

relations.note: Della is dedicated to the resistance against them.
relations.quote: Della is dedicated to the resistance against the Phyrexians
Della found and rescued Errant and Parnesse
